observation: In the observed range, fixed512 chunk latency rises below/around2K then largely plateaus over2K..16K past. Longer prompts incur more near-constant-cost blocks; not evidence of rapidly growing per-block latency throughout this range.

decision.retain: Prioritize current post2K per-block work and serial PP dependency after complete acceptance.
decision.do_not_assume: Do not select a quadratic-with-past bottleneck or accumulating slowdown as established by long TTFT alone.
decision.no_runtime_change: No hot edit, new instrumentation, GPU experiment or Native change. Existing PP2 two-independent-microbatch results do not qualify same-request PP4 chunk pipelining.

measurement_limits: Same run and fixed chunk T512; no baseline/candidate experiment or speedup.
Past also tracks execution order; ratios are descriptive, not causal.
Later-stage Native intervals include upstream dependencies and collectives, not pure GPU compute.
Stage intervals overlap; do not add stages or subtract them to identify pure compute/network.
Final partial chunks and decode excluded; no physical peak TPS inferred.
Pooled bins contain different request subsets; same-request ratios are also reported.
Only stage0 and stage3 rank0 observed; no all-rank utilization or all32K-past coverage.
No exact operator attribution at the2K transition; source identity followup remains pending authorization.
No physical certified BF16 roof, achieved speedup or whole-agent qualification inferred.
